risks.title: DogSceneView node cleanup on dispose (API-correct remediation unverified)
risks.evidence: lib/render/dog_scene_view.dart dispose() only nulls the runtime. VERIFIED via fscene.dev API docs (0.22.1): flutter_scene Scene has NO dispose() method; cleanup surface is remove/removeAll + node-level disposal. Earlier claim 'never disposes _scene' was inaccurate. initializeStaticResources() re-runs per widget instance.
risks.impact: Possible retained GPU/node references across scene recreations; magnitude unproven without device profiling
risks.ai_fixable: deferred - requires flutter_scene 0.23.0 API verification (Scene.removeAll/Node disposal semantics) plus on-device memory profiling; speculative change refused per mission rules
